title: AI App Store index
description: The list of published apps. One entry per app, pointing at a git repo that holds an aias.yaml.

apps.description: Sorted by name. One entry per published app.

name.description: Must equal the name field in the app's aias.yaml, and must be unique in this index.

repo.description: HTTPS git URL of the app repository. The user's machine clones it and builds locally.

ref.description: Branch or tag to clone. A tag is recommended once the app has releases.

description.description: One line shown in the store listing.

tags.description: Optional, for humans searching the store.

homepage.description: Optional project page, when it is not the repo itself.
